check.question: Return up to three team IDs and their positive backlog counts at the end of March 31, 2026, ordered by count descending and then team ID ascending.
check.sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.ticket_id, e.seq, e.occurred_at, s.to_status, a.to_team_id
  FROM ticket_events e
  LEFT JOIN ticket_status_events s ON s.event_id = e.event_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket_assignment_events a ON a.event_id = e.event_id
  WHERE e.occurred_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
),
last_status AS (
  SELECT ticket_id, to_status AS status
  FROM (
    SELECT ticket_id, to_status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, seq DESC) AS rn
    FROM ev WHERE to_status IS NOT NULL
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
last_team AS (
  SELECT ticket_id, to_team_id AS owning_team_id
  FROM (
    SELECT ticket_id, to_team_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, seq DESC) AS rn
    FROM ev WHERE to_team_id IS NOT NULL
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT lt.owning_team_id AS team_id, COUNT(*) AS backlog_count
FROM last_status ls JOIN last_team lt ON lt.ticket_id = ls.ticket_id
WHERE ls.status IN ('open', 'pending')
GROUP BY lt.owning_team_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY backlog_count DESC, owning_team_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

The required team_id ASC tie-break admits team 30 into the top 3 and drops team 40; reversing the tie-break to team_id DESC swaps them. Pending counts as backlog (pool demotions 1006/1011/1019); the April 1 midnight close of 3001, the April 1 midnight transfer of 4001 (50->60), and the at-cutoff creation of 3002 are all outside the March replay, leaving team 90 = 3 (2001, 2002, 3001), team 50 = 1 (4001), team 60 = 0, team 80 = 0, team 70 nonexistent (created 2026-04-10); zero-backlog teams are excluded by the positive-count filter, so none reaches the top 3.
